title: Frontend component design upgrade - spec suite (prd + requirements + RTM)

requirements.text: Design tokens SHALL govern every component: 48px minimum tap targets (compact 40px in list rows only), 24px 2px-stroke line icons with no text-character icons, 48px inputs with 16px text, 8px corner radius (chips full pills), 4/8/12/16/24 spacing, 12/14/16/20/22 type scale with nothing under 12px, weights 400 and 600 only, and a 2px accent focus ring on keyboard focus.

acceptance_criteria.then: it is a 24px SVG line icon in a 48px tap area with no permanent border box and no text character used as an icon

acceptance_criteria.when: a text input, select or search field is inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: it is 48px high with 16px text, 12px inner padding and 8px corners
only 12/14/16/20/22 appear, weights are 400 or 600, and nothing is smaller than 12px
a 2px accent outline is visible

requirements.text: Input borders SHALL be #868e96 in light theme and #8b949e in dark theme, at least 3:1 contrast against the card surface (#ffffff / #161b22).

acceptance_criteria.given: light theme renders an editable input on a card
acceptance_criteria.then: it is #868e96 at 3:1 contrast or better against the surface

acceptance_criteria.given: dark theme renders an editable input on a card
acceptance_criteria.then: it is #8b949e at 3:1 contrast or better against the surface

requirements.text: Colour semantics SHALL be built into one token set where blue marks actionable and Watching, green good or received, amber needs-attention, red only missed/error/remove/destructive, grey secondary; important values use normal text colour; and the overlapping aliases --bg/--page-bg, --card/--card-bg/--white, --danger/--danger-fg/--invalid-bg map to one token each.

acceptance_criteria.given: status or feedback colour is applied
acceptance_criteria.then: it carries the agreed meaning and red never appears as decoration
it uses the normal text colour, never grey

acceptance_criteria.given: the stylesheet is audited after consolidation
acceptance_criteria.then: each alias group maps to one token with no page still using a removed alias

requirements.text: The top bar SHALL show the page name (not the app name), search and the bell; theme, Hide amounts and Help SHALL live in the three-dot menu; there SHALL be exactly one Help button replacing Why bonds? and Page guide; every icon-only control SHALL keep its aria-label; and icons SHALL use normal text colour with only the alert badge coloured.

acceptance_criteria.then: page name, search and bell are present and no repeated page heading sits below
exactly one question-mark Help button exists
it carries an aria-label and no title-attribute-only explanation

requirements.text: The alert bell badge SHALL be a red circle of at least 18px with 12px weight-600 digits showing 9+ over nine and hidden at zero; the alert list SHALL open on tap (never hover-only), close on tap-outside and Escape, show each message at 14px with a 12px grey friendly time below, carry a 4px severity bar (red missed, amber due today), head with Alerts in sentence case, and end with See all alerts and Mark all as read.

acceptance_criteria.then: it shows 9+
it is hidden
the list opens without hover; tap outside or Escape closes it
message 14px, time 12px grey on the second line, 4px severity bar on the left

requirements.text: Field pattern SHALL be: label above at 14px normal colour with 6px gap, real-example placeholders in grey never repeating the label, read-only fields with grey background and no border, errors as red 1px border plus one short red line under the field shown only when the error happens, rupee prefix and percent suffix as visual-only overlays, 48px search box with the Search company or ISIN placeholder, and native date/select pickers kept with only the outer box styled.

acceptance_criteria.then: label above, 14px normal colour, real-example placeholder
grey background, no border, visibly non-editable
red border and one red line under the field, shown only then

acceptance_criteria.given: a money or percent field renders
acceptance_criteria.then: the sign is a visual overlay and the value is unchanged

requirements.text: Remarks SHALL follow the rule table: no remark on obvious fields (Company, Broker, Coupon, Rating agency), rules shown only when broken, examples in placeholders, warnings in the confirmation dialog, explanations behind help popups of at most two short sentences at 14px about 260px wide opened from a 16px question-mark icon with a 48px tap area, one popup open at a time closing on tap-outside or Escape, reusing the existing tip-wrap code; the only permanent helper allowed is Earlier bonds from this company when history exists.

acceptance_criteria.then: no help icon and no permanent remark

acceptance_criteria.when: another is opened or the user taps outside or presses Escape
acceptance_criteria.then: the open one closes and only one popup is open at a time

acceptance_criteria.given: the page renders permanently visible helper text
acceptance_criteria.then: only errors and the one allowed history label remain

requirements.text: ISIN lookup SHALL report through one thin line about 20px high directly under the ISIN field, mapped from the six existing data-fetch-state names (idle shows no line; checking/found/notfound/offline/downgrade map to the five visual states), changing in place with no layout shift, never red, never blocking the form, with try again and See sources as plain blue links, the button reading Looking up... or Try again in 60s during work or wait, per-field source labels consolidated behind See sources, and the Fetched details popup keeping its apply/enter-manually role.

acceptance_criteria.then: the mapped text and icon show in place and nothing below moves
it is never red and the form is never blocked
the data-fetch-state values and showState() contract are unchanged

requirements.text: Buttons SHALL use two sizes (48px normal with 16px weight-600 text; 40px compact with 14px text only inside list rows), three styles (primary filled blue once per screen; secondary outlined blue; destructive red text or outline with filled red only on the final confirm), a borderless text style for low-priority actions, sentence-case verb-first labels of one to three words, Cancel left and main action right, 8px corners, enabled-with-message instead of disabled where possible, and the merged class set replacing .btn/.btn-sm/.btn-secondary/.btn-primary/.mark-read-btn.

acceptance_criteria.then: at most one filled primary button and two sizes only
red styling with filled red only on the final confirm
Details text button, Move to portfolio outlined, Remove bond only inside Details

requirements.text: Chips SHALL be 12px weight 600 with 4px 8px padding as full pills; status chips SHALL be Watching blue, Holding green, Matured grey, Missed red; the rating SHALL show as a chip on the second line beside the ISIN banded AAA to AA- green, A+ to A- blue, BBB+ and below amber, not rated grey, never red, with a fixed minimum width; outlook SHALL follow the rating with an arrow only for Positive or Negative; the agency SHALL appear only in Details.

acceptance_criteria.when: its band is computed from the string
acceptance_criteria.then: the chip colour matches the band and is never red
they share a fixed minimum width

acceptance_criteria.given: an outlook of Positive or Negative renders
acceptance_criteria.then: the word follows the rating with a small arrow; Stable has none

requirements.text: List rows SHALL present the fixed fact order: watchlist rows as company name with status chip, ISIN grey then rating chip, Expected yield on the right at 20px with the 12px grey label below, coupon and broker in one grey line, then actions; portfolio rows as company name with status chip, ISIN grey then rating chip, Amount invested as the biggest number, next payment date, red only for a missed payment; numbers right-aligned with tabular digits and consistent decimals; the Details panel not repeating the row; privacy mode hiding only rupee amounts.

acceptance_criteria.then: name+chip, ISIN+rating chip, yield figure right, coupon/broker line, actions
name+chip, ISIN+rating chip, amount figure, next payment date
rupee amounts masked, coupon and yield percentages visible

requirements.text: The add bond form SHALL open at step one showing only ISIN, the Fetch bond details button and the status line with all server-required fields present in the DOM under their existing names, expand to the bond facts after a successful lookup with the rare fields collapsed under More details, show all fields when the lookup fails, group the move to portfolio form into Dates, Amount and Optional under existing names, and start the number of bonds field empty.

acceptance_criteria.then: only ISIN and the fetch control are visible while all server-required field names exist

acceptance_criteria.given: a successful lookup re-renders the form
acceptance_criteria.then: the bond facts appear and the rare fields sit under a collapsed More details row
all fields are visible for manual entry
three groups (Dates, Amount, Optional) under the existing field names

requirements.text: Destructive actions SHALL confirm through one in-app dialog titled Remove <company>? with the body This can't be undone., Cancel on the left and Remove bond on the right in red, closable by Cancel, Escape and the Android back button, and the existing delete request SHALL execute unchanged on confirm.

acceptance_criteria.then: title names the company, body says it cannot be undone, Cancel left, red Remove bond right

acceptance_criteria.when: Cancel, Escape or the Android back button is used
acceptance_criteria.then: it closes and nothing is deleted
the existing delete form posts to its unchanged URL

requirements.text: Messages SHALL say what happened then what to do with no Error: prefix or technical text; successes SHALL be short, past tense, without exclamation marks or the word successfully; empty states SHALL carry a heading naming the space, one line of explanation and one button.

acceptance_criteria.then: no Error: prefix and a what-to-do next step
short past tense, no exclamation mark, no successfully
heading, one explanation line, one button

requirements.text: The section 4.12 wording table SHALL be applied across pages (Watchlist, Add bond, Fetch bond details, Expected yield, Where you found it, Price per bond, Number of bonds, Interest start date, Interest credit day, Move to portfolio, Remove bond, Mark all as read, Alerts, How this page works, plain alert messages), in sentence case with no ampersands, please, successfully, dashes joining fragments or exclamation marks, and the same word for the same thing on every page; NCD and SDI get one-line help popups.

acceptance_criteria.when: labels are audited against the table
acceptance_criteria.then: the new terms are present and the old terms absent
sentence case, no ampersands, no please, no successfully, no exclamation marks

requirements.text: Platform parity SHALL hold: nothing hover-dependent, no title attribute as the only explanation, the shortcut hint hidden on touch with the shortcut kept on web, 48px tap targets and inputs and 16px input text on both platforms, native pickers styled only outside, Escape closing popups on web and the Android back button closing them first on Android, labels wrapping at Android largest font size, and both themes verified with no Android-only or web-only component CSS.

acceptance_criteria.then: tap, click and keyboard focus all work; no hover-only path

acceptance_criteria.given: a popup or dialog is open
acceptance_criteria.when: Escape or Android back is used
acceptance_criteria.then: the popup closes before leaving the page
labels wrap and nothing is cut off

requirements.text: Mobile navigation SHALL be bottom tabs only (Dashboard, Portfolio, Watchlist, Goals, More) with the hamburger drawer absent on mobile, the sidebar kept on desktop, and the More tab opening and closing reliably (regression of issue #203).

acceptance_criteria.then: bottom tabs are the one navigation and no hamburger drawer exists
the sidebar remains as today

acceptance_criteria.given: the More tab is tapped twice
acceptance_criteria.then: it opens and closes reliably

requirements.text: The implementation SHALL change no logic, business flow, data format, URL, form field name, element id, validation or accessibility attribute (the design adapts to the code); SHALL NOT delete a class or token still used by any page (renames go add-new, switch-pages, remove-old); SHALL keep the layout and security gate tests green (test_layout_fixed_px_sweep, test_layout_container_clamp, test_layout_multiwidth_audit, test_tc44_hardcoded_headers, test_tc46_suppression_scan, test_tc49_no_secrets); and SHALL stop and ask when a component outside the design doc is met rather than inventing a style.

acceptance_criteria.then: no logic, flow, data, URL, field-name, id, validation or accessibility changes

acceptance_criteria.given: the layout and security gates run
acceptance_criteria.then: all named tests stay green
the pass stops and asks for a rule

requirements.text: The four known bugs SHALL be fixed during the rollout: the number of bonds field starting empty with minimum-one validation intact, the Invested label rupee presentation moved inside the field with no empty span left, privacy mode keeping coupon and yield percentages visible while masking only rupee amounts, and the alert list opening on tap rather than hover only.

acceptance_criteria.given: the add bond form opens fresh
acceptance_criteria.when: the number of bonds field renders
acceptance_criteria.then: it is empty and validation still requires at least 1
percentages stay visible and rupee amounts are masked

acceptance_criteria.given: a touch user taps the bell
acceptance_criteria.then: it opens on tap

requirements.text: The rollout SHALL run tokens and shared stylesheet components first, then pages one at a time in the order Watchlist, Portfolio, Dashboard, Goals, Alerts, Settings, About, Feedback, with each page gated on the section 7 component and platform checklists (both themes, both platforms) and a short report of what changed, what was left and what needs a decision.

acceptance_criteria.then: tokens and shared components land before any page pass
the order Watchlist, Portfolio, Dashboard, Goals, Alerts, Settings, About, Feedback holds
both checklists pass and the report names changes, leftovers and decisions needed

prd_items.statement: The system SHALL present every interactive element through one shared token set (48px tap targets, 24px line icons, 48px inputs with 16px text, 8px radius, 4/8/12/16/24 spacing, 12/14/16/20/22 type scale, weights 400/600, 2px accent focus ring) on web and Android from one stylesheet.
The system SHALL render input borders at 3:1 contrast or better against the card surface using #868e96 in light theme and #8b949e in dark theme.

The system SHALL carry colour semantics in one token set (blue actionable/Watching, green good, amber attention, red only missed/error/remove, grey secondary), keep important values in normal text colour, and consolidate the overlapping token aliases.

The system SHALL show a top bar with the page name, search and bell, hold theme/Hide amounts/Help in the three-dot menu, provide exactly one Help button, and label every icon-only control with an aria-label.

The system SHALL show the alert bell with a badge (9+ over nine, hidden at zero), open the alert list on tap with close on tap-outside or Escape, present messages at 14px with 12px friendly times below, mark severity with a 4px left bar, and write messages in plain words.

The system SHALL render fields with labels above at 14px, real-example placeholders, distinct read-only styling, on-demand red errors under the field, a visual rupee prefix and percent suffix that do not change input values, and the search box at 48px with the Search company or ISIN placeholder.

The system SHALL show remarks only as error text, the one allowed history label, or two-sentence help popups behind 16px question-mark icons with one open at a time, closing on tap-outside and Escape, with no help icons on obvious fields.

The system SHALL report ISIN lookup through one thin in-place status line mapped from the six existing fetch states, never red, never blocking the form, with plain-blue action links and unchanged data-fetch-state script names.

The system SHALL use two button sizes (48px normal, 40px compact in list rows only), three styles (primary filled once per screen, secondary outlined, destructive red with filled red on final confirm only), a borderless text style, Cancel left and main action right, and 8px corners.

The system SHALL render status and rating chips as 12px weight-600 pills with banded rating colours (AAA to AA- green, A+ to A- blue, BBB+ and below amber, not rated grey, never red), fixed rating chip width, outlook arrows for Positive/Negative, and the agency name only in Details.

The system SHALL present watchlist rows (name+status chip, ISIN+rating chip, Expected yield largest at 20px, coupon/broker grey line, actions) and portfolio rows (name+status chip, ISIN+rating chip, Amount invested largest, next payment date) in the fixed order with right-aligned tabular numbers, no Details repetition, and privacy masking rupee amounts only.

The system SHALL start the add bond form short (ISIN + Fetch bond details + status line) and expand after lookup, group the move form into Dates/Amount/Optional, keep every server-required field in the DOM under its existing name, and start the number of bonds field empty.

The system SHALL confirm destructive actions with one in-app dialog titled Remove <company>? with the body This can't be undone., Cancel left and red Remove bond right, closable by Cancel, Escape and the Android back button, executing the unchanged delete request on confirm.

The system SHALL write errors as what-happened plus what-to-do without technical prefixes, successes as short past tense without exclamation marks, and empty states as heading plus one line plus one button.

The system SHALL apply the section 4.12 wording table (Watchlist, Add bond, Fetch bond details, Expected yield, Where you found it, Price per bond, Number of bonds, Interest start date, Interest credit day, Move to portfolio, Remove bond, Mark all as read, Alerts, How this page works) in sentence case with no ampersands, please, successfully or exclamation marks.

The system SHALL keep nothing hover-dependent, never rely on title tooltips alone, hide the shortcut hint on touch, keep 48px targets and 16px input text on both platforms, close popups via Escape and the Android back button, and survive Android largest font size and both themes with no platform-only component CSS.
The system SHALL use bottom tabs as the only mobile navigation with the hamburger drawer absent on mobile, keep the sidebar on desktop, and keep the More tab opening and closing reliably.

The system SHALL change no logic, business flow, data format, URL, form field name, element id, validation or accessibility attribute; never delete a class or token still in use; keep the layout and security gate tests green; and stop to ask when a component outside the design doc is met.

The system SHALL fix during the rollout: the number of bonds field starting empty with minimum-one validation intact, the Invested label rupee presentation inside the field, privacy mode leaving coupon and yield percentages visible, and the alert list opening on tap rather than hover only.

The system SHALL roll out tokens and shared components first, then pages one at a time in the order Watchlist, Portfolio, Dashboard, Goals, Alerts, Settings, About, Feedback, gating each page on the section 7 checklists with a short report.
